notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with haste.The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Warstorm Surge, causing the Insect to deal one damage to Body of Knowledge.
Body of Knowledge triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
